programme.title: Loop
programme.sub-title: Shorts: Finding My Purpose Through Ceramics
programme.desc: AJ Simpson became the first non-binary winner of `The Great Pottery Throwdown' in 2022, when they wowed the judges, and the nation, with their impressive ceramics. Known for their signature `blobs', AJ lives and works in their native Aberdeen. Meet AJ in the studio they share with partner Celda and rescue dog Leo, learn about AJ's experience of growing up queer in the city, and more recently, embracing their non-binary identity, as they take a walk along the seafront.

programme.title: Hidden Lives
programme.desc: Samantha Little explores an extremely mucky pre-wedding ritual popular in the north of Scotland. They begin a passionate, illicit and sexually liberating love affair.

programme.title: Stand by Me
programme.desc: Bittersweet film about a gang of four 12-year-old boys growing up in Oregon in the 1950s. Adapted from 'The Body', a novella by Stephen King.
